name: SoFi Technologies
outlook:
What SoFi Technologies says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted net revenueManagement now expects to deliver adjusted net revenue of approximately $4.75 billion to $4.85 billion which implies approximately 32% to 35% annual adjusted net revenue growth year-over-year.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAManagement continues to expect adjusted EBITDA of approximately $1.6 billion, which equates to an annual adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 33% to 34%.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted net income and EPSManagement also continues to expect adjusted net income of approximately $825 million, which equates to a margin of approximately 17%, and adjusted EPS of approximately 60 cents per share.
  • Full year 2026: member growthFor 2026, management continues to expect to increase total members by at least 30% year-over-year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed July 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
